reviewContext.issueReference: round-5-audit:feat/ai-capture@70977f468c57c5c34cc55c1cd1487e89b7a72bfe (base 0a35708); no GitHub issue; workflowInput.requestedOutcome is the issue body
reviewContext.userProblem: The round-5 audit found six defects in 3D CAD pages and AI capture: a shared cut that empties one visible target leaves the trimmed visible sibling without a discrepancy note; the CAD kernel and worker exports fail to compile under noUncheckedIndexedAccess; the interference lattice scans dense mesh bins before charging any work; open-mesh picture rays allocate and sort a vector per sample; PCB outline resolution rescans linked graphics for every reference; and capture diagnostics shorten ids against page scope, so a printed token can delete an unrelated element.
requiredOutcomes: function-capture-visible-sibling-cut-report (R5-1; f1): the trimmed visible sibling gets a sampled cad.result.empty naming the failed feature, the emptied target and itself in CLI text, CLI JSON and desktop export; hidden-target precedence and text unchanged; rail-only control has no note; editor keeps rail at 800 mm^3.

function-cad-kernel-strict-indexed-reads (R5-2; f2): cad-ui.tsx, cad-kernel index.ts and worker.ts compile with zero diagnostics under noUncheckedIndexedAccess; truncated Manifold buffers throw Invalid Manifold mesh data; valid output unchanged.

performance-interference-mesh-triangle-scans (R5-3; f3): scan cost charged before intervals in pair sampler and census against 1,024 entries per weighted ray; stacked-plates visits bounded and capped; 1 and 5 threads identical on a multi-pair scene; admitted cube-mesh pair matches literals pinned before the change.

performance-open-mesh-nearest-hit-allocation (R5-4; f4): one-pass nearest facet; open-square allocations below samples/16; oracle equality incl. -0.0/+0.0 and bin-order ties; overlap and equal-depth digests pinned before the change hold at 1 and 4 threads.

performance-cad-pcb-outline-page-rescans (R5-5; f5): reads grow at most 4.5x for 4x input for separate pages and a shared N-segment board, via prepareCadCapture and evaluateCadPage; scene digest unchanged; per-reference thickness; closed widening updates bounds, body key and kernel calls.

maintainability-capture-diagnostic-id-scope (R5-6; f6): structural and sampled capture tokens match cad check; edit resolves them to the failed feature and the unrelated element survives; JSON keeps full ids.
nonGoals: No edits to crates/capture/src/raster.rs, crates/capture/src/raster/**, crates/capture/src/prism.rs, crates/capture/src/census.rs, crates/capture/src/lib.rs, crates/capture/src/report.rs, capture goldens or docs/capture.md.
No NCS1 or report JSON change, no golden regeneration, no error code change, no package boundary change.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true, rustfmt on touched Rust files.
Each plan uses CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/<planId> and artifactRoots ["target", "tmp/cad3d"].
Per-plan gates are focused; typecheck, lint, mise run verify and mise run test-cli run once at integration.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R5-1 sibling attribution in describeBodies only; sibling replaces today's hidden-then-own attribution only when strictly earlier.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Report already carries emptiedByStep and the model carries tool identity; preserves R4-1 output and removes Rust chains.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R5-2 coverage checks before the numProp-3 fast path, plus per-read guards.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Checked reads alone miss truncated buffers whose loop bounds skip required values.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R5-3 charge_scan on BoundaryBudget reusing the exhausted flag; visits counted by a cfg(test) counter in ToolView::intervals.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Existing capped and unknown propagation never claims emptiness; mesh.rs stays with f4.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R5-4 strict total_cmp Less in one pass sharing the facet helper with hits_impl.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Equals the stable sort's first element.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R5-5 scan-local page outline memo and per-page graphics key.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Linear in shared-page and separate-page workloads; invalidation by new scan.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R5-6 renderCadCapture takes document elements for short ids.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Single caller cannot pass a page-scoped map by mistake.

intentionalTradeoffs: R5-3 caps rather than scans meshes whose average bin occupancy exceeds 1,024 entries per weighted ray; the result is capped or unknown, never a wrong claim.
R5-1 does not resolve chains of rejected shared steps beyond each body's first discrepancy.
supportedEdgeCases: Hidden and visible targets of one shared cut, open bodies, unknown census bodies, truncated Manifold buffers, empty meshes, zero-length runs, equal-depth and signed-zero facets, many references to one board, cross-page exact-prefix id collisions.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Reproducing the app's skip-and-fail-dependents behaviour in capture; dense real meshes above the scan allowance.
